column1: # Store entries that aren't games: engines, tools, soundtracks, extras,
# streaming services. not_games.py (every refresh) marks them
# ownership.kind = 'launcher', so the portal, IGDB matching and the MCP
# server skip them, like the Lutris launchers. Remove a line to bring the
# entry back (its kind is restored on the next refresh).
# store_id may be a glob pattern (* and ?): UE_* = every Unreal Engine version.
